Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Boiler Services
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Inspection Coordinator, Smith & Sons Boiler Services, (555) 123-4567, john.doe@smithandsonsboilers.com
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Boiler Services specializes in the installation and repair of residential and commercial boiler and furnace systems. Our services include routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and system upgrades to ensure optimal performance and compliance with environmental regulations. We focus on safe and efficient operation of heating systems, utilizing experienced technicians trained in the latest industry standards. Our commitment to safety and regulatory compliance ensures that all operations are conducted without the use of cranes or high-pressure systems, minimizing risk and providing peace of mind to our clients.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Environmental and Regulatory Compliance: Installation or repair involving chemical
treatments or fuel systems must comply with environmental regulations. Noncompliance can
result in fines or claims related to pollution or contamination.
Industry-Specific Restrictions
• Prohibition on Crane Use: The use of cranes or heavy lifting equipment is disqualifying
unless operators are certified and the insured has documented safety procedures. This restric-
tion is due to the high risk of catastrophic injury or property damage associated with crane
operations in boiler and furnace work.
• Exclusion of High-Pressure Boiler Work: High-pressure boiler systems (typically oper-
ating above 15 psi) are excluded due to the specialized skills, certifications, and elevated risk
of explosion or severe injury.
